verdict.rationale: Amazon Chime SDK is a cloud communications service that processes customer audio, video and messaging data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-usage policies or opt-out controls. The pack covers only media, messaging, PSTN and documentation probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
